headline: Social Organization Sets Up 24/7 ‘Feedback Booth’ In London To Let Critics Air Grievances Directly Into A Potted Fern
body:
In a bold move toward radical transparency, a major social organization has installed a soundproofed, velvet-lined feedback booth in central London, allowing critics of its top leadership’s international travel to vent their frustrations directly to a meticulously pruned Boston fern. The organization claims that the initiative, titled ‘Project Open Leaf,’ ensures that every complaint is heard in a neutral, foliage-rich environment where the listener is strictly prohibited from interrupting or issuing press statements.

“We felt that digital discourse was losing the calming essence of nature,” said the organization’s spokesperson, who spent three hours yesterday teaching the fern how to maintain a look of polite, vegetative concern. “By placing these critics in front of a plant, we guarantee a dialogue that is entirely one-sided, non-confrontational, and carbon-neutral. The fern doesn't judge, it doesn't tweet, and it certainly doesn't write contradictory op-eds; it simply absorbs the CO2 of the grievances and grows.”

Critics who have visited the booth report that the experience is surprisingly cathartic, despite the plant’s refusal to acknowledge the validity of their geopolitical arguments. “I spent forty minutes yelling about the implications of the tour, and the fern just kept swaying in the draft,” said one local activist who emerged from the booth feeling significantly more relaxed. “Honestly, it offered more constructive engagement than my last three email threads. The fern did lose a leaf halfway through my critique of the delegation’s itinerary, but I took that as a sign of deep, structural emotional processing.”

Plans are reportedly underway to expand the program to include a ‘Dissent Cactus’ in Berlin and an ‘Opinion Bonsai’ in Tokyo, ensuring that global criticism remains firmly rooted in the decorative arts. Meanwhile, the London-based fern has been promoted to ‘Senior Listener’ and is currently being considered for a honorary board position, provided it continues its rigorous schedule of doing absolutely nothing in response to provocative questions.
caption: New feedback strategy: just tell the plant exactly what you think. It's the ultimate listener, really. #LondonDiaries #ProjectOpenLeaf #PoliticalSatire #RSS (satire)
igHook: Would you feel heard if you poured your heart out to a piece of shrubbery?
imagePrompt: A high-end, minimalist wooden booth situated on a bustling London street corner with a large, lush fern plant sitting prominently on a pedestal inside visible through a glass pane.

sourceHeadline.title: RSS says of critics of Mohan Bhagwat’s UK trip: ‘Let them speak, we’re open to dialogue’
